column1: In the UBP Networking Database you can view the outcomes of over 5,000 current and previous UNC Kenan-Flagler undergraduate students (from 2013-present) who have elected to serve as a networking resource for business students when completing the Future Plans Survey.  From here you can not only network with target employers and grad programs, but also explore career paths and learn from other students and alumni.

As you can see, the database is broken up into three sections:
*Current UBP Intern Acceptances - current UBP students who reported an internship offer
*UBP Alumni Job Acceptances - graduated or soon to be graduated UBP students who reported a full-time job offer
*Post-Grad Education Acceptances - graduated UBP students who reported pursuing programs of further study

The information in this tab includes the name, class year, employer, type of position (full-time or intern) and title OR program of study and institution, and personal email.  Most of this information was provided at the time of their graduation and their current location, employer, and/or job title may not be accurate. Using this information in conjunction with LinkedIn and HeelsEngage will give you an accurate and strong network of UNC Kenan-Flagler alumni and current students to engage with throughout your job or grad school search process.

Note: This document is updated each year in October.                                                                                                                                                                 If you have any questions, contact the UBP Career Team (ubpcareers@kenan-flagler.unc.edu).
